flags.observation: "nullify investigation" closes the line as a recited power label, not an aside or inversion.
"agreed to a ninety-nine-year WTC lease signed" is ungrammatical; the line stumbles at 109 characters.
"investors, empire" leaves the power word dangling without syntax; the card's tiny own-money stake claim is missing.
"paid back initial equity and control" reads as control being returned, inverting the card's claim that control was kept.
"specific and commercial" is a hollow fragment; the card's first-on-the-planet claim vanishes, line explains nothing and lands nowhere.
Opener callbacks ("Those ten veils", "That recovery exposes", "Those odds") all point at the immediately preceding card; no long-range callback.
Openers repeat one noun-verb template ("The data surfaces", "The investigation leaves paper"); objects carry bridges, no character want or grudge (Tip 3).
"firm formerly chaired by CIA" makes the agency the chair; the card names a person at the CIA.
"admitted knowing a DOD staffer; cashed out a day before" lets the named person read as the one who cashed out.
"nine point five million transactions, advanced knowledge" drops the SEC inversion; sounds as if the SEC confirmed advanced knowledge.
"The inquiry meets a verdict" and similar bridges stay abstract; artwork picture words are nearly absent throughout (Tip 5).
At 125 characters with opener, the line exceeds one breath; "first rule Follow the Money rejected; little significance" crowds the close.
